text: answer[task-30b2c150]: locked The locked frame with rail "paper" references lock ref "0xfdd4adec8c72a6560856912ea4480304355562f2df990bd4501080a1257d9aaa", but the transcript shows no corresponding receipt frame from the payer confirming the lock on that rail.
